original_test_intent: Verify every byte in the Type 13 reserved region is the version-required value, normally zero, remains distinct from the adjacent Flags and Current Language fields, and is unchanged after reboot.
original_method: Validate the Type 13 formatted length, extract the exact reserved byte range from raw structure data, compare every byte and aggregate mask to the applicable SMBIOS rule, retain neighboring-field offsets as boundary evidence and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the SMBIOS layout/rule, any documented vendor exception and reboot plan. No firmware rewrite is permitted.
required_inputs: Applicable SMBIOS version and canonical Type 13 offsets/length
Expected reserved-region value, normally all zero
Any authoritative vendor-extension exception bound to exact firmware/platform
Raw Type 13 parser and evidence format
safety_requirements: Read raw SMBIOS only; never rewrite reserved bytes or firmware.
Validate formatted length and exact offsets so Flags or Current Language are not accidentally included in the reserved region.
Preserve every raw byte; decoded dmidecode text may omit reserved storage and `grep Reserved` may match unrelated output.
Treat any nonzero byte as an evidence/spec issue unless an authoritative version-specific exception exists; do not invent vendor meaning.
Stop on layout ambiguity, truncated structure, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Extract and compare the exact Type 13 reserved byte array with offset/length provenance before/after reboot.
Do not assign meaning to nonzero reserved data, modify firmware or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact layout/rule and any vendor exception evidence.
Approve reboot/recovery, adjudicate nonzero reserved data and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The command is not a reliable validator because reserved bytes are commonly suppressed in decoded output and the grep is not bound to Type 13 offsets.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive raw Type 13 formatted bytes, validate structure length and report the exact reserved offset range byte-by-byte plus an all-zero/nonzero mask and adjacent-field boundaries.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 13 Reserved scope, source script and 5/5-minute values are retained; the legacy grep remains recorded but is not sufficient evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a version-aware raw parser to validate Type 13 length, extract only the canonical reserved byte range and assert the approved value for every byte while retaining boundary evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 13 BIOS Language Information structures.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS and parser versions and the exact layout used.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 13 formatted layout and reserved-byte requirement, authoritative vendor documentation for any exception and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces an unscoped likely-empty grep with exact raw offset/length validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Increases coverage by checking all reserved bytes and preventing adjacent-field contamination.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Canonical versioned layout and exception policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A nonzero reserved byte indicates nonconformance or undocumented extension; it must not be decoded speculatively.

project_override_considerations: A project cannot generally redefine reserved bytes; any exception requires authoritative vendor documentation for the exact platform/firmware and must preserve the raw nonzero evidence.
expected_evidence: Approved SMBIOS version, Type 13 layout, reserved rule and vendor-exception decision
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 13 structure with length, reserved offsets and every byte
All-zero/nonzero result with adjacent Flags/Current Language boundary proof
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot byte diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The canonical Type 13 reserved region is identifiable from the versioned raw layout; the unsuitable grep affects method only.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Raw offset validation safely determines the field; unavailable parser or rule is readiness, not permanent ambiguity.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects unscoped decoded grep and requires raw offset-bound byte evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains version/vendor safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Explicitly separates nonzero evidence collection from engineer-owned conformance verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a false pass from omitted decoded output and prevents neighboring Flags/Current Language bytes from being mistaken for reserved data.
independent_technical_reasoning: The reserved region is a fixed byte range in a versioned Type 13 structure; length and byte-value checks are deterministic software operations.
